verdict.rationale: Per-call machine payments are a fair question for an agentic commerce and payments product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents carts, checkouts, buyer handoff and order tracking for merchant goods. Nothing mentions HTTP 402 payment-required responses, pay-per-call API monetization, or charging agents for service calls; AP2 mandates and the cart-tied payment authorizations concern goods checkout, not metering an API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monetize an API or service with HTTP 402 machine payments that agents pay per call without a checkout UI
